info.name: WordCraft integration
info.summary: Write and edit Word and OpenDocument files in Nextcloud with the WordCraft word processor
info.description:
Open a Word (.docx, .docm, .dotx, .doc), OpenDocument text (.odt) or RTF file in Files with **Edit in WordCraft** and work on it right in the browser: styles, tables, pictures, headers and footers, comments, track changes, references, mail merge and more.
- **Save** writes the document straight back to Nextcloud, which keeps the previous state as a file version. - **Save As** and **Export** (PDF, ODT, RTF, plain text…) store a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a document in Files opens it in WordCraft.
WordCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Documents go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software or document server.
This is a community integration. [WordCraft](https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft) is an open-source, Rust-native word processor by the ArtCraft team; this app embeds a build of it and is not affiliated with them.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
